components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the stored value is those 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID

## Summary

Added an optional `email` field to owners that is validated for syntactic correctness and stored/returned lower-cased, rejecting an invalid address with 400.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property (`type: string`, `format: email`, `maxLength: 255`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. The generator's `performBeanValidation` turns `format: email` into a `@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email` constraint on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto`. Leaving it out of `required` means a missing email is accepted. The existing `ValidateOwner` (`@Valid`) + `ValidationExceptionHandler` pipeline turns an invalid email into a **400** automatically — no new exception wiring needed.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the `email` field (`@Column(name = "email")`), getter/setter, and `toString()` entry.

3. **`rest/function/owner/OwnerEmails.java`** (new) — Single source of truth for email normalization (null-safe `toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`), mirroring the existing `OwnerTelephones` helper.

4. **`BuildOwner.java`** (create/POST) and **`ApplyOwner.java`** (update/PUT) — Both now set the entity's email via `OwnerEmails.normalize(...)`, so the stored value is lower-cased on both paths.

5. **Schemas** (`db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — Added a nullable `email` column to the `owners` table.

6. **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — The seed inserts used positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)`, which broke once the column count changed. Gave them an explicit column list (`id, first_name, …`) so the new `email` column defaults to NULL. (Tests run under the `hsqldb` profile.)

**Tests:** The full suite is green — `AcceptanceTest` (`coreLowercasesEmail`, `errorRejectsInvalidEmail`, `functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail`) passes, and `BUILD SUCCESS` with 0 failures/errors overall.
